title: The public demo never phones or messages a real person
plain: In sandbox mode (the drill anyone can run from this site), Doorstep cannot place a real phone call, send a volunteer, message the volunteer group or contact a family member over a real channel. This rule is a "forbid", so it wins over every rule that would otherwise allow those actions.
protects: Real people, from strangers trying the demo.
checked_by: Sandbox forbid beats every permit on a real channel
Deny call in drill and sandbox modes

title: Real calls only to people on the list, at reasonable hours
plain: Doorstep may place a real check-in call only when all of these are true: it is a live incident (not a drill), the number is on the approved call list, the resident agreed to be called, fewer than 3 calls went to them in the last hour, and it is between 8 AM and 9 PM local time. Late calls are allowed only for the most severe alerts, or when the operator tests with their own phone. The code checks the call list a second time before dialling.
protects: Residents, from calls they did not agree to or calls in the middle of the night.
checked_by: Deny call to non allowlisted number
Deny call after three attempts in an hour

title: Only an available volunteer nearby can be sent to a door
plain: Doorstep may send a volunteer to check on someone only if that volunteer is marked available and lives within 3 km. The short brief about the resident travels only to that one volunteer. For high-risk residents the captain must approve the visit first.
checked_by: Assign volunteer requires available and within 3 km

title: Group messages never name a resident
plain: Doorstep may message the whole volunteer group, but only if the message contains no resident details. Anything about a particular person goes to one assigned volunteer or the captain, never to the group.
checked_by: Deny group broadcast containing resident details
Allow group broadcast without resident details

title: Family is contacted only with the resident's consent
plain: Doorstep may contact a resident's family member only if the resident agreed to that in advance.
protects: Residents' say over who hears about them.

title: Only a person can record an emergency call
plain: Doorstep never calls emergency services. When someone may be in danger it tells them to call 911 and pages the captain at once. Only the captain (a person) can record that an emergency call was made; the agent's attempts are refused and logged.
protects: Everyone, from an AI deciding it has handled an emergency.
checked_by: Deny agent recording an emergency call but allow the captain

title: Looking things up and closing a case are always allowed
plain: Reading the roster, scoring who to call first, finding relief centres or nearby volunteers, setting a reminder to check again, sending a resident a safety tip, paging the captain and closing a case change nothing outside Doorstep, so they are always allowed.
protects: The check-ins themselves: the safe steps are never blocked.
checked_by: Read only and always permitted tools
Unknown tool is denied fail closed

title: Practice calls happen only in drills and the demo
plain: Simulated check-ins, where a fictional resident is played by a model, may run only in drills and in the sandbox, never during a real incident.
protects: A real incident, from being mixed up with practice.
